parsed.observations: The wheat leaf has numerous small, round to oval orange-brown pustules scattered across the blade, with dense irregular clusters near the midrib. Separate white, powdery-looking surface colonies are visible. No clear necrotic blotches with black dots are apparent.
parsed.summary: Leaf rust is the predominant disease, supported by scattered orange-brown pustules, with separate white surface colonies consistent with powdery mildew.
